newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura, DKB to receive stiff penalties - MOF quoted.
newsitem.headline: Nomura, DKB to receive stiff penalties - MOF quoted.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) will impose stiff penalties against Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd for their involvement in a racketeer payoff scandal, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Wednesday.

Penalties against the two financial institutions would be a decisive step towards regaining trust and preventing similar incidents, and were an important start for ensuring fairness in the market, he was quoted as saying.
Jiji also quoted Mitsuzuka as saying he wanted the two firms to overcome their penalties and improve their business practices.
